Messages.Author: tigernat
Messages.Body:
If a vampire plays Fear of the Void Below @ superior and the opposing minion strikes catatonic fear, will the strike resolution effect of the FotVB still take place?

[dai] Only usable before range is determined. Each round of this combat defaults to long range, and this vampire gets an optional press each round, only usable to end combat.
[DAI] As [dai] above, and the opposing minion's controller discards one card at random from his or her hand during the initial strike resolution phase of each round.

Vegas gNat

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> tigernat wrote:
> If a vampire plays Fear of the Void Below @ superior and the opposing minion strikes catatonic fear, will the strike resolution effect of the FotVB still take place?
>
No.
[LSJ 20070223] : "During strike resolution effects are pre-empted by S:CE (think of Carrion Crows)".
